title: Critical routing flaw in Gemini CLI – Background utility limits block main Pro model

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is a clear and actionable bug report detailing a flaw in model routing and fallback handling, where rate limits on background utility models cause the CLI to switch or block the primary active model (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). Complete client environment details were provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires a targeted logic adjustment in packages/core/src/config/config.ts to ensure activateFallbackMode only updates the active model if the primary model failed, alongside updated fallback handler logic in packages/core/src/fallback/handler.ts and unit tests in packages/core/src/fallback/handler.test.ts.

summary.problem: Rate limiting or failure in background utility models (e.g. utility_router, utility_loop_detector) switches or blocks the explicitly configured main model (e.g. gemini-3.1-pro-preview).
summary.root_cause: In packages/core/src/config/config.ts, activateFallbackMode unconditionally mutates the main active model (_activeModel) whenever a fallback occurs, even when the failure occurred in a non-active background utility model.
summary.context: Background utility tasks execute using dedicated or lightweight models. When these models experience quota/rate limits, the fallback mechanism should register runtime overrides for the specific failed utility model without altering the user's explicitly configured primary model.

steps: In packages/core/src/config/config.ts, modify activateFallbackMode(model, failedModel) so that setModel(model, true) is only invoked when failedModel is undefined or matches the active model.
In packages/core/src/config/config.ts, ensure that when failedModel is distinct from activeModel, activateFallbackMode records the fallback override mapping without mutating _activeModel.
In packages/core/src/fallback/handler.ts, verify processIntent passes failedModel to activateFallbackMode when an auxiliary model fails so that only the utility model override is updated.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When a background utility model fails, fallback overrides are set for that utility model while the primary model remains unchanged and active.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in handler.test.ts simulating a fallback event where failedModel differs from activeModel.
Verify that activateFallbackMode sets fallbackOverrides for failedModel without changing activeModel.
Execute Vitest suite to ensure no regressions in fallback behavior.
